sessions.title: Todo List with Filter
strengths: Identified that TodoProvider should own the todo state and todo modification functions.
Recognized that TodoInput needs access to the functions defined by TodoProvider.

struggles: Had difficulty clearly defining the role and responsibility of each component.

Knew React Context conceptually but struggled to identify when and how to apply it to the concrete problem.

learned: React Context can establish communication between components when one component needs access to state or functions owned by another provider.
TodoProvider owns the todo state and operations while TodoInput owns the input interaction.
Context itself is not a component; it provides a communication mechanism that a provider supplies values through and consumers access.
React state arrays should be updated by producing a new array rather than mutating the existing array.
reinforce: React Context: createContext, Provider, and useContext.
Reasoning from requirements to component responsibilities.
Identifying which component owns state and which components need to consume or modify it.
Mapping concrete problems to applicable React concepts.
sessions.recurring_weakness: Difficulty reasoning about relationships between components, variables, and concepts when working from explicit requirements.
sessions.recurring_strength: Able to identify conceptual relationships and connect ideas when reasoning freely, especially after externalizing thoughts.
